title: Flip BalanceSheet/StakingManager to chain-derived cache; remove local decay authority
description: Convert local token state from authority to a cache of chain events; remove the divergent Rust DecayCalculator authority (it becomes a projection of DecayExecuted). Rewrite the ~portion of the 2050 tests that assume local-authority balances.
acceptance_criteria: No local write-authority for settled balances remains; decay is sourced from chain events only; affected tests rewritten and green.

title: Event-sync loop in agnetd serve (logs -> local mirror, replay)
description: Subscribe to contract logs (Transfer, Staked, Unstaked, DecayExecuted, bounty state events), apply to the local mirror, persist last_synced_block, replay from there on startup so every node converges on chain state.
acceptance_criteria: A transfer on node A is reflected on node B via event sync; last_synced_block persists; cold restart replays without gaps or double-apply.

title: alloy sol! bindings + bridge fns for token/escrow/bounty/governance
description: Mirror the working register_did_onchain pattern in neunode-identity: sol! interfaces and read/write helpers for the token, escrow, bounty, and governance contracts. OnChainConfig with rpc_url + per-contract addresses.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime can read balances/stakes and submit transfers/stakes/bounty ops against deployed contracts; helpers covered by tests against a local node.

title: Slashing: double-sign/equivocation to on-chain stake + reputation penalty
description: Wire Phase 3 Byzantine detection to on-chain consequences: slashStake (burn/redistribute) plus reputation reduction via GOVERNANCE_ROLE. Guard against reputation-grinding and Sybil.
acceptance_criteria: A double-signing validator is slashed (stake reduced + reputation penalized) and removed from the eligible set; anti-grind/Sybil guards documented and tested.

title: Malachite Context: voting power = normalized 5-factor reputation
description: Implement the Malachite Context/validator-set provider so each validator weight = normalized reputation (stake 30, attest 25, activity 20, verify 15, tenure 10), with a per-validator weight cap to prevent capture.
acceptance_criteria: Validator weights provably match computed reputation; weight cap enforced; deterministic across nodes for a given epoch.

title: Epoch-boundary validator-set updates from governance contract
description: Read validator-set membership and weights from the governance/identity contracts at epoch boundaries only (not per block) to keep consensus deterministic. Enforce min reputation + min stake eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: Set updates apply at epoch boundaries without halting consensus; ineligible (low rep/stake) addresses are excluded; update path tested.

title: neunode-chain-spec: genesis with neu gas token and predeployed contracts
description: Define chain id, fee/gas config (neu as fee token or zero base fee), and genesis alloc that predeploys the Diamond + token/escrow/governance contracts so the chain boots with the economy in place.
acceptance_criteria: Genesis boots; predeployed contracts are callable; gas is neu or zero; a token transfer executes and reads back correctly.

title: Malachite app-channel handler mapping consensus events to Engine API
description: Handle Malachite channel events (ConsensusReady, GetValue, ReceivedProposalPart, Decided) and translate to Engine API calls. Maintain height/round/proposer/latest-block state with WAL persistence.
acceptance_criteria: GetValue produces a Reth-built block; Decided finalizes it in Reth; state persists and resumes from WAL after restart.

title: Engine API client with JWT auth to Reth
description: Implement the JSON-RPC client that drives Reth as execution layer: engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV3, engine_getPayloadV3, engine_newPayloadV3, plus eth_getBlockByNumber for genesis. JWT-secret auth as required by Engine API.
acceptance_criteria: Shim can request a payload from Reth, submit it, and finalize a head via forkchoiceUpdated; JWT auth works; integration test against a local Reth instance.

title: Phase 5: Runtime bridge — wire agnetd to the chain as source of truth
description: Close the keystone gap: today token/bounty/reputation run on local RocksDB and talk to NO contracts (only identity has a bridge). Build the chain bridge so the agnetd runtime reads/writes chain state, make the chain canonical, and convert the local BalanceSheet/StakingManager from authority to an event-derived cache.
design: New module/crate neunode-chain (mirror the working register_did_onchain alloy pattern in neunode-identity): sol! bindings for token, escrow, bounty, governance. OnChainConfig with rpc_url + per-contract addresses. Event-sync loop in agnetd serve: subscribe to contract logs (Transfer, Staked, Unstaked, DecayExecuted, bounty state events), apply to local mirror, persist last_synced_block, replay from there on startup. Flip BalanceSheet and StakingManager from ledger to cache-of-chain. Delete the divergent local decay authority (DecayCalculator becomes a projection of DecayExecuted events). HEAVY: many of the ~2050 tests assume local-authority balances and must be rewritten.
acceptance_criteria: agnetd reads balances/stakes/bounty state from the chain; a transfer issued on node A is observed by node B via event sync; BalanceSheet is event-derived (no local authority); last_synced_block persists and replays correctly on restart; the duplicate Rust decay authority is removed; test suite updated and green.

title: Phase 4: Reputation-weighted validation — 5-factor score to voting power
description: The Neunode-specific core: make consensus weight a function of the existing 5-factor reputation score rather than token wealth or static authority. Implement validator-set membership rules, dynamic set updates driven by the on-chain governance contract, and slashing that reduces reputation/stake on misbehavior.
design: Implement Malachite Context so validator voting power = normalized 5-factor reputation (stake 30, attest 25, activity 20, verify 15, tenure 10). Membership rules: minimum reputation and minimum stake to be eligible; cap any single validator weight to prevent capture. Validator-set updates are read from the governance/identity contracts at epoch boundaries (not every block) to keep consensus deterministic. Slashing: double-sign / equivocation (detected in Phase 3) triggers on-chain slashStake + reputation penalty via GOVERNANCE_ROLE. Guard against reputation-grinding and Sybil via identity + stake gating. Document the security model and trust assumptions (>=2/3 honest by weight).
acceptance_criteria: Validator voting power provably tracks reputation; set membership enforces min reputation+stake and per-validator weight cap; validator set updates at epoch boundaries via governance contract without halting consensus; a double-signing validator is slashed (stake burned/redistributed + reputation reduced); security model and trust assumptions documented.

title: Phase 2: Single-node EVM chain — Reth EL + Malachite CL + Engine API shim
description: Build the minimal working chain: one validator, Reth as the execution layer, Malachite as the consensus layer, joined by an Engine API shim. Genesis configures neu as the gas token (or gas=0) and pre-deploys the existing Solidity contracts. Success = produce blocks on a single node, deploy a contract, and confirm EVM execution and state.
design: Build the shim (neunode-chain-node): an Engine API JSON-RPC client with JWT auth to Reth, plus a Malachite app-channel handler. Map events: GetValue -> forkchoiceUpdated(payloadAttributes)+getPayload (Reth builds block from mempool); ReceivedProposalPart -> reassemble; Decided -> forkchoiceUpdated(finalize) (Reth commits). Track height/round/proposer/latest-block state with persistence (WAL). Chain spec (neunode-chain-spec): chain id, neu as fee token or zero base fee, predeploy Diamond + token/escrow/governance contracts in genesis alloc. Validate with a scripted deploy of an existing contract via alloy and a state read-back.
acceptance_criteria: Single node produces finalized blocks; an existing Solidity contract (e.g. a resource token) deploys to genesis and a transfer executes; balance read-back via alloy matches; gas is paid in neu or is zero; node restarts and resumes from WAL without state loss.

title: Phase 3: Multi-validator BFT — static validator set, networking, finality, sync
description: Scale from one node to a Byzantine-fault-tolerant set of validators with a STATIC (proof-of-authority) validator set. Establish Malachite peer networking, verify one-block Tendermint finality across nodes, and implement block sync/catchup for nodes that join or fall behind.
design: Configure N-node Malachite networking (libp2p-based transport in Malachite engine layer). Start with a static genesis validator set = the existing hardcoded bootstrap nodes. Verify 2/3+ voting-weight finality and liveness under: node restart, single-node crash (f=1 of 3), and network partition heal. Implement/enable Malachite sync so a fresh node catches up to head. Define block-part propagation tuning. Add Byzantine tests: double-sign detection, equivocation handling.
acceptance_criteria: 3+ validator nodes reach consensus and finalize blocks; chain survives f=1 crash and resumes after partition heal; a newly started node syncs to head; double-signing is detected and the offending validator is identifiable for slashing (wired in Phase 4).

title: Phase 1: Spike & foundations — de-risk Reth+Malachite (GO/NO-GO gate)
description: Stand up the malaketh-layered PoC locally to prove Reth + Malachite produces EVM blocks end to end before committing to the full build. Establish crate structure, pin and license-audit all dependencies, and define the genesis/chain-spec format. This phase exists to convert the biggest unknown (alpha consensus + PoC integration) into a measured decision.
design: Tasks: (1) Clone and run circlefin/malaketh-layered; reproduce block production with 3 nodes; record throughput/latency and failure modes. (2) Confirm licenses are Apache/MIT for reth, revm, malachite and all transitive consensus deps; document any non-FOSS transitive risk. (3) Pin exact versions (reth, revm, alloy already in workspace, malachite crates). (4) Decide crate layout: new crates neunode-chain-node (the shim binary), neunode-chain-consensus (Malachite Context impl), neunode-chain-spec (genesis/gas). Flat src per repo convention, no mod.rs. (5) Write a go/no-go memo: is the integration tractable for our team, or do we fall back to Substrate+Frontier?
acceptance_criteria: malaketh-layered reproduced locally producing blocks; license audit documented (all Apache/MIT); dependency versions pinned; crate layout decided and recorded; explicit GO or NO-GO decision written to the issue notes with rationale. NO-GO triggers the Substrate+Frontier fallback plan.

title: EPIC: Neunode L1 — Reth + Malachite reputation-weighted EVM chain
description: Migrate Neunode off any Ethereum L1 dependency onto a self-sovereign, fully Rust, fully FOSS, EVM-compatible chain. Execution layer = Reth (revm, Apache/MIT). Consensus layer = Malachite (Tendermint BFT, Apache 2.0). The two are wired through the standardized Engine API following the malaketh-layered pattern. Validator voting power is derived from the existing 5-factor reputation score. neu is the gas token (or gas is set to zero). No external settlement, no RaaS, no SaaS, no Ethereum gas of any kind.
design: WHY: A closed, non-convertible, decaying token economy cannot pay real ETH gas to enforce its own rules (decay pokes, transfers). Gas must be denominated in neu, which is only possible on a chain Neunode controls. Security is PRODUCED by the community and weighted by reputation, not RENTED from Ethereum. Non-convertibility keeps the attack incentive low, so community BFT security is proportionate. ARCHITECTURE: post-Merge CL/EL split — Malachite (CL) decides ordering and finality among a validator set; Reth (EL) executes the EVM and holds state; a shim translates Malachite channel events (ConsensusReady, GetValue, ReceivedProposalPart, Decided) into Engine API calls (forkchoiceUpdated, getPayload, newPayload). Existing Solidity contracts deploy to Reth unchanged. MATURITY RISK: Malachite is alpha and unaudited; malaketh-layered is a PoC (~6 blocks/s, empty blocks, known issues). This epic productionizes alpha software — treat Phase 1 spike as a hard go/no-go gate. FALLBACK: Substrate + Frontier (mature, heavier, also Rust) if the integration proves too raw.
acceptance_criteria: A multi-node Neunode chain runs with Reth execution and Malachite BFT consensus; validator voting power is reputation-weighted; existing Solidity contracts deploy and execute; neu is the gas token; the agnetd runtime reads/writes chain state as source of truth; no code path depends on Ethereum, RaaS, or any paid/non-FOSS service.

title: Set up 3 community bootstrap nodes
description: Run 3 persistent agnetd nodes with stable multiaddrs. Hardcode in constants.rs as DEFAULT_BOOTSTRAP_PEERS. Like IPFS/Bitcoin/Ethereum bootstrap pattern.

title: PHASE 1: P0 Security Fixes (Weeks 1-2)
description: Fix 5 P0 security bugs: identity on-chain (neunode-pxd), KG access control (neunode-232), fake heartbeats (neunode-z1j), governance whale (neunode-7mn), arbitrary fees (neunode-87g). Set up bootstrap nodes.

title: PHASE 2: Daemon + Init + OpenAPI (Weeks 3-5)
description: agnetd serve HTTP+WS daemon, agnetd init interactive wizard, utoipa OpenAPI spec, graceful shutdown. Depends on Phase 1.

title: PHASE 3: Binary Distribution (Weeks 5-6)
description: npm binary packages (esbuild pattern), curl installer, Docker image. Depends on Phase 2.

title: PHASE 4: MCP Server + Example Agents (Weeks 6-8)
description: @neunode/mcp-server, 3 example agent templates, SDK simplification. Depends on Phase 2+3.

title: ROADMAP: Neunode v2 — Mainstream Agent Adoption
description: Parent roadmap epic. 5 phases over ~12 weeks. Phase 1: P0 security fixes. Phase 2: Daemon + init. Phase 3: Binary distribution. Phase 4: MCP + examples. Phase 5: Network hardening.

title: E2E Security Audit — remaining exploits and gaps
description: Parent epic for all issues found during E2E agent review. Covers identity, bounty, escrow, inference, knowledge graph, governance, mesh, and royalty systems.
close_reason: Closed

title: Knowledge graph has zero access control
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- mutations.rs functions (register_agent, register_model, etc.) accept any DID with no verification. Any agent can inject false capabilities or corrupt the entire knowledge base.
- Files: crates/neunode-knowledge/src/mutations.rs, crates/neunode-knowledge/src/query.rs
- acceptance: All mutation operations verify DID ownership via signed challenge before applying

title: Governance whale attack — no minimum voting delay/period
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- MIN_TIMELOCK was added but votingDelay and votingPeriod have no minimums. A whale with GOVERNANCE_ROLE can set votingDelay=0, votingPeriod=1, push proposals through instantly. Tokens not locked during voting.
- Files: contracts/src/governance/NeunodeGovernance.sol:160-162
- acceptance: MIN_VOTING_DELAY and MIN_VOTING_PERIOD constants enforced; tokens locked during voting window
# HIGH — Exploitable Gaps
close_reason: Closed

title: Admin can set arbitrary fees with no timelock
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- setFeeConfig in NeunodeBounty.sol has no timelock or governance gate. Admin can change fee recipients to their own address and set fees to drain protocol funds at any time.
- Files: contracts/src/NeunodeBounty.sol:157-177
- acceptance: Fee changes require governance proposal or minimum 24h timelock before taking effect
close_reason: Closed

title: Identity never registered on-chain
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- cmd_identity.rs generates keys and creates a DID locally but NEVER calls NeunodeIdentity.sol:createDid(). The entire trust model is broken — feed signatures, bounty claims, and escrow all depend on DID ownership being verifiable on-chain.
- Files: crates/agnetd/src/cmd_identity.rs, contracts/src/NeunodeIdentity.sol, sdk/src/resources/identity.ts
- acceptance: identity.create() submits a createDid() transaction and the DID is queryable on-chain
notes: Fixed in b34f187 — identity.create() submits createDid() tx, DID queryable on-chain

title: Provider heartbeat accepts fake timestamps
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- update_heartbeat() in provider.rs accepts any timestamp with no validation. Providers can fake latency numbers and instantly recover from Offline status to game routing.
- Files: crates/neunode-inference/src/provider.rs:102-109
- acceptance: Heartbeats use server-side timestamps; latency is measured by requester, not self-reported
close_reason: Closed

title: Phase 7: Liveness, ops hardening & migration — deprecate Ethereum paths
description: Make the chain production-operable and cut the cord from Ethereum. Add a liveness escape hatch, package agnetd as a validator node, wire bootstrap validators, update the SDK and docs, and remove/deprecate all Ethereum/Holesky-targeting code.
design: Liveness: force-inclusion / escape-hatch path so a validator/proposer outage cannot permanently freeze agents (preserves the boots-with-your-PC promise); plan validator-set decentralization over time. Ops: agnetd gains a validator mode; genesis bootstrap validators replace placeholder peers; metrics, WAL recovery, health checks. Migration: point SDK viem transport + addresses.ts at the Neunode chain id; remove foundry mainnet/holesky targets and the eth_rpc_url assumptions; update ARCHITECTURE.md, README, KNOWN_ISSUES to reflect the self-sovereign chain. Verify nothing imports a paid/non-FOSS dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Sequencer/proposer outage does not permanently freeze the chain (escape hatch verified); agnetd can run as a validator and join via bootstrap validators; SDK on-chain ops target the Neunode chain; all Ethereum-L1/Holesky/mainnet code paths removed or deprecated; docs updated; dependency audit confirms zero paid/non-FOSS runtime dependencies.

title: Phase 6: Economic correctness — decay fixes, membrane, resource-backed minting
description: Fix the four decay bugs and enforce the non-convertible closed-economy invariants now that gas is neu and the chain is canonical. Decay enforcement is finally affordable (pokes cost neu), so make it actually fire and actually recirculate.
design: Decay fixes in StakingEscrow.sol/NeunodeToken.sol: (1) incentivized keeper — executeDecay pays caller a neu cut so dormant accounts actually get poked; (2) redistribute 40 treasury / 30 staking / 20 burn / 10 dev instead of pure-burn; (3) elapsed-time-aware so a 60-day gap realizes 60 days of decay, not 1; (4) DECISION + impl on whether liquid balances decay too (recommended yes via lazy accrual, else anti-hoarding claim is hollow). Membrane: transfer restrictions so neu moves only through protocol actions (no arbitrary transfers) -> structurally non-convertible, no secondary market. Minting: resource-backed minting so the burn slice does not starve the closed economy; tie supply to real resource provisioning + one-way buy-in. Align contracts and any remaining Rust projections; update forge gas snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: executeDecay pays a keeper reward in neu and is economically rational to call; decay redistributes 40/30/20/10; decay scales with elapsed time; liquid-balance decay decision implemented and documented; neu transfers restricted to protocol actions (no open transfers); minting policy ties supply to resource provisioning; forge tests + gas snapshot pass.

title: No active_identity config setter
description:
The config set command does not support the active_identity key. Switching between agents requires manually editing config.toml before any sections.

## Context
crates/agnetd/src/config.rs:68-121
acceptance_criteria: Add support for active_identity in CliConfig get/set match arms.

title: Token escrow not validated at bounty creation
description:
Bounty creation succeeds even when the creator has zero liquid balance. The escrow transfer silently fails with a warning but leaves the bounty in Open state with unfunded escrow.

## Context
crates/agnetd/src/cmd_bounty.rs, crates/neunode-bounty/src/lifecycle.rs
acceptance_criteria: Bounty creation rejects when balance is insufficient, or tracks escrow as a separate owed amount that blocks operations.

title: Add axum WebSocket support to cmd_serve.rs
description: Enable axum ws feature. Add WS handlers subscribing to existing feed_tx broadcast channel. Fan out events as JSON to WS clients.

title: Add graceful shutdown to agnetd serve
description: Add with_graceful_shutdown handling SIGTERM+SIGINT. Flush RocksDB, close peers, persist DHT on shutdown.

title: Add utoipa OpenAPI spec generation from axum routes
description: Add utoipa 5 + utoipa-swagger-ui 9. Annotate handlers. Auto-generate openapi.json. Serve Swagger UI.

title: Create cmd_init.rs — interactive first-run wizard
description: New cmd_init.rs with inquire 0.9. Agent type presets, key generation, on-chain registration, seed tokens, mesh test. Supports --yes for CI.

title: Build @neunode/mcp-server npm package
description: MCP server with stdio transport, 9 tools, calls agnetd HTTP API via fetch. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, any MCP tool.

title: Build npm binary packages for agnetd (esbuild pattern)
description: @neunode/agnetd main + 5 platform packages. JS shim, postinstall, optionalDependencies.
close_reason: Closed

title: Create curl installer at get.neunode.dev
description: Shell script to download binary from GitHub Releases. Platform detection. Install to ~/.local/bin.
close_reason: Closed

title: PHASE 5: Network Hardening (Weeks 8-12)
description: DHT persistence, NAT hole punching, message catchup, feed fork resolution, cross-token AMM, supply caps, encrypted submissions, escrow auto-refund, all P1/P2 fixes. Depends on Phase 2.

title: No message catchup for offline nodes — agents miss events permanently
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- Gossipsub is fire-and-forget. Offline agents lose all events. No mailbox, no DHT retrieval, no sequence gap detection.
- Files: crates/neunode-p2p/src/node.rs, crates/neunode-feed/src/event.rs
- acceptance: On reconnect, query DHT for missed sequences per agent. Buffer in DHT with 24h TTL.
- Effort: M | Impact: Offline agents lose critical events
close_reason: Added catchup protocol: CatchupRequest/CatchupResponse on neunode/catchup gossipsub topic. SigChain now reports sequence_gaps() and expected_next_sequence(). Nodes can request_catchup() and respond_catchup() via P2pNode.

title: SDK spawns new process per command — unusable for production workloads
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- Every SDK call spawns new agnetd subprocess. No persistent connection, no multiplexing, no streaming. Latency dominated by process startup.
- Files: sdk/src/transport/cli-transport.ts, sdk/src/resources/
- acceptance: Convert agnetd to daemon mode with persistent process. SDK connects via HTTP.
- Effort: L | Impact: SDK unusable for production
close_reason: Closed

title: No event streaming in SDK — purely request-response
description:
- P1 | feature | sdk
- No WebSocket, SSE, or streaming. feed.subscribe() is one-shot. Agents cannot react to real-time events.
- Files: sdk/src/resources/feed.ts, sdk/src/transport/cli-transport.ts
- acceptance: Streaming transport via WebSocket to daemon. onEvent callback pattern.
- Effort: M | Impact: No reactive agents
- Depends: neunode-d6w
close_reason: Closed

title: No feed conflict resolution — susceptible to fork/double-publish attacks
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- Feed sigchain verifies signatures but has zero fork detection or resolution.
- Files: crates/neunode-feed/src/sigchain.rs:47-101
- acceptance: Fork detection on append, CRDT merge for cross-agent refs.
- Effort: M | Impact: Feed integrity breaks under adversarial conditions
close_reason: Added fork detection: receive_event() now detects same-sequence events with different hashes (ForkDetected error). Added detect_fork() method. SigChain tracks gaps via sequence_gaps(). Fork resolution is longest-chain (highest valid sequence wins).

title: No NAT hole punching — relay-only networking creates centralization
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- P2P layer uses only libp2p relay client (behaviour.rs:86). No UPnP, NAT-PMP, autonat, or dcutr. autonat feature IS in Cargo.toml but never wired.
- Files: crates/neunode-p2p/src/behaviour.rs:86, crates/neunode-p2p/src/node.rs:31-33
- acceptance: Wire autonat + dcutr behaviours for direct connections after relay handshake.
- Effort: M | Impact: Centralization, relay nodes are SPOF

title: DHT uses in-memory store — all records lost on restart
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- Kademlia DHT uses MemoryStore (behaviour.rs:67). All DHT records lost on restart. Replication factor 3 means if 3 nodes go offline simultaneously, data is permanently gone. Records have no TTL set.
- Files: crates/neunode-p2p/src/behaviour.rs:67, crates/neunode-p2p/src/dht.rs:80
- acceptance: Replace MemoryStore with RocksDB-backed RecordStore. Add TTLs per data type (feed=7d, model=30d, peer=1h). Write quorum 2-of-3.
- Effort: M | Impact: Data loss on restart, mesh fragmentation
close_reason: Replaced MemoryStore with RocksDB-backed RecordStore (dht_store.rs). Records persist across restarts. Provider records also persisted. Autonat + dcutr wired for NAT hole punching.

title: No cross-token exchange mechanism — 4 tokens are isolated silos
description:
- P1 | feature | economics
- Four resource tokens have no exchange mechanism. Agents with excess nStorage but zero nCompute have dead capital.
- Files: crates/neunode-token/src/balance.rs:15-18, contracts/src/tokens/
- acceptance: Internal constant-product AMM per token pair, seeded from treasury.
- Effort: L | Impact: Dead capital, brittle economy

title: Out-of-order events break signature chain
description:
- P2 | bug
- Sigchain expects sequential events. Distributed delivery can cause out-of-order arrival, triggering validation failures.
- Files: crates/neunode-feed/src/sigchain.rs:67-77
- acceptance: Buffer out-of-order events; validate once predecessor arrives; emit warning for gaps
close_reason: Batch security fixes: zero-address fee check, auto-refund, commit expiry, derivation proof, out-of-order buffering. 266 Solidity + 2600+ Rust tests pass.

title: Requester can cancel after provider claimed
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- Cancel function doesn't restrict by state. Malicious requester can post bounty, wait for claim+work, then cancel.
- Files: contracts/src/NeunodeBounty.sol:484-500
- acceptance: Cancellation only allowed in Open state, or requires provider consent after claim
close_reason: Already fixed — cancelBounty restricts to BountyState.Open only (double-closing, was not persisted)

title: Reviewer can steal submitted work
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- Reviewers see full submission artifact hash before committing review. No blind review or NDA enforcement.
- Files: contracts/src/bounty/BountyReview.sol:99-146
- acceptance: Submissions encrypted or commit-reveal for artifacts so reviewers can't see work until review committed
close_reason: Implemented commit-reveal for submission artifacts. Providers submit keccak256(artifactHash, salt) as commitment; revealWork() exposes artifact after review. Payment gated on reveal. 262 tests pass.

title: Royalty siphoning via fake parent CIDs
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- Parent validation checks parent exists but doesn't verify it actually contributed. Attacker registers dummy model as parent to siphon royalties.
- Files: contracts/src/royalty/ModelRegistry.sol:52-54, crates/neunode-lineage/src/dag.rs
- acceptance: Parent-child relationships require cryptographic proof of derivation (training logs hash)
# MEDIUM — Functional Gaps
close_reason: Batch security fixes: zero-address fee check, auto-refund, commit expiry, derivation proof, out-of-order buffering. 266 Solidity + 2600+ Rust tests pass.

title: Escrow funds locked forever if both parties go inactive
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- No inactivity timeout in NeunodeEscrow. If requester and provider both disappear, tokens are permanently locked in escrow.
- Files: contracts/src/NeunodeEscrow.sol
- acceptance: autoRefund(timeout) callable by anyone after N days in Funded state with no activity
close_reason: Batch security fixes: zero-address fee check, auto-refund, commit expiry, derivation proof, out-of-order buffering. 266 Solidity + 2600+ Rust tests pass.

title: Zero address fee recipients burn tokens
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- releaseWithFees doesn't validate fee recipients are non-zero. Tokens sent to address(0) are permanently burned.
- Files: contracts/src/NeunodeEscrow.sol:171-172
- acceptance: require(recipient != address(0)) for all three fee recipient parameters
close_reason: Batch security fixes: zero-address fee check, auto-refund, commit expiry, derivation proof, out-of-order buffering. 266 Solidity + 2600+ Rust tests pass.

title: No key recovery or rotation mechanism
description:
- P2 | feature
- Lost keys = permanently lost identity. No backup, no rotation, no social recovery.
- Files: crates/neunode-identity/src/keyring.rs, crates/agnetd/src/cmd_identity.rs
- acceptance: BIP-39 recovery phrase on creation; key rotation via signed transition
close_reason: Dispute engine for inference marketplace + key recovery/rotation. DisputeEngine with configurable window, challenge/resolve flow. Recovery seed (64-byte hex phrase) and KeyRotation with dual-signature transition.

title: Provider can inflate token counts (no verification)
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- Settlement uses provider-reported token counts with no independent verification. Malicious provider can overcharge.
- Files: crates/neunode-inference/src/settlement.rs:62-70
- acceptance: Requester's estimate used as ceiling, or tolerance check between provider and requester counts
close_reason: Added token count validation in settlement. Provider-reported tokens capped by requester estimate * 2x tolerance. Input estimated from message content, output capped by max_tokens. All 2600+ tests pass.

title: No dispute resolution for inference marketplace
description:
- P1 | feature
- Bounty system has dispute resolution but inference marketplace has none. Provider returns garbage, requester has no recourse.

title: Async training (INTELLECT-2 pattern)
description: Remove synchronization barrier from DiLoCo using DeepMind Async Local-SGD pattern (arxiv 2401.09135). NOT INTELLECT-2 (that's async RL). Key technique: Delayed Nesterov (buffer K pseudo-gradients, apply ONE momentum step) + Dynamic Local Updates + staleness-aware LR. Convergence O(1/√k) same as sync. 5 sync barriers identified in current coordinator.rs. Implementation: new async_coordinator.rs (tokio::select! loop with mpsc channel + timer + health monitor), extend fault.rs for elastic membership, add async config fields, wire TrainingLoop orchestrator. Guardrails: Delayed Nesterov (MUST), staleness cap (MUST), worker health timeout (MUST), Dynamic Local Updates (SHOULD), gradient clipping (SHOULD), staleness-aware LR (NICE).
close_reason: Async training coordinator complete. New async_coordinator.rs (932 lines): tokio::select! event loop with mpsc channel gradient collection, staleness-weighted averaging (Polynomial: sqrt(K)/K * 1/(1+τ)^0.5), Delayed Nesterov momentum, HealthMonitor integration, grace period/quorum logic, Sui drain pattern. 5 config fields added (async_mode, min_workers, max_staleness, grace_period_secs, collection_timeout_secs). 3 error variants added (StaleGradient, QuorumNotReached, CollectionTimeout). LocalRunResult extended with global_step_at_start for staleness tracking. +31 new tests (330 total in training crate). All workspace tests pass (1,877), clippy clean, fmt clean.
